stock.description: KFM Kingdom Holdings Limited operates as an investment holding company primarily engaged in the global production and sale of precision metal components, specifically metal stampings and lathing products. Its extensive market reach spans the People's Republic of China, North America, and Europe. Beyond its core offerings, the firm also manufactures and trades fine metal goods and sensor technology products, alongside providing a range of management services. The company offers a comprehensive suite of integrated solutions. This includes design engineering and prototyping, advanced computer numerical control (CNC) capabilities for laser cutting, tooling design, and mold creation, as well as the precise lathing and machining of parts. KFM Kingdom handles both hard and soft tooling requirements. Subsequent processing steps involve secondary operations like laser and robotic argon welding, riveting, tapping, drilling, polishing, and sandblasting. A full spectrum of post-treatment services, such as silk screen printing, heat treatment, plating, and various coatings, is also available, culminating in product assembly and rigorous quality assurance testing. Clients can further leverage its expertise in custom packaging solutions. Its diverse clientele is drawn from sectors including medical and testing equipment, financial systems, consumer electronics, network and data storage infrastructure, and office automation. Established in 1987, KFM Kingdom Holdings Limited maintains its headquarters in Tsuen Wan, Hong Kong, and functions as a subsidiary of Massive Force Limited.
